name: reserved_denoiser_channels_v27
hypothesis: A weight-derived set of eighteen atom channels and eighteen denoiser token channels can be reserved for a future analytic parity program with limited damage to the pretrained prediction. This checkpoint is the zero-signal capacity control, not a repair hypothesis.
selection: Rank only original checkpoint readout norms. Use no structures, labels, predictions, or fitted coefficients to select channels.
evaluation: Fresh paired base and control predictions on the fixed eight-system development pilot. Report all four chemistry metrics and protein CA displacements. The test split remains unused.
limitation: LayerNorm statistics still couple the reserved and retained channels. Zeroing readers does not guarantee preservation of pretrained behavior.
